BMI: A set of four normal breast tissues was also collected after a breast-reduction surgery at Lund University Hospital and used to generate the DIA spectral library. This subset of samples was selected based on the following clinical criteria: a breast volume of more than 800 mL, no previous case nor familial history of breast or ovarian cancer, nonsmoker, no diabetes mellitus, and a body mass index below 30.
